content: IEM ASOS 1-minute endpoint https://mesonet.agron.iastate.edu/cgi-bin/request/asos1min.py accepts station (3-letter FAA code, e.g. AUS/CRP/MAF/ELP, NOT 4-letter KAUS), vars=tmpf,sknt,drct, sts/ets ISO timestamps, sample=1min, tz=UTC, what=download. Returns CSV: station,station_name,valid(UTC),tmpf,sknt,drct (F, knots, deg). Live-confirmed for all 4 target airports.
